item.title: FrontlineBrowse 1.1.1
item.description: FrontlineBrowse 1.1.1 simplifies Settings with a compact list, smaller headings, and a sidebar that becomes a menu in narrow windows. Removes promotional dashboard copy and extra About panels. Includes the signed GitHub update channel and FrontlineBrowse Publisher. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.

item.title: FrontlineBrowse 1.1
item.description: FrontlineBrowse 1.1 introduces the Frontline Control Center, a redesigned Settings experience, and signed automatic updates. Includes the native Frontline Workspace menu, frontline:// internal addresses, and AAC/H.264 playback. Fixes theme caching so the app bundle remains unchanged while running. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization remain pending.

channel.title: FrontlineBrowse Updates
channel.description: Signed FrontlineBrowse releases for Apple Silicon Macs.
